title: JANUS Blue Book — Deterministic Spot-Check Validation Receipt
purpose: Record validation progress for the immutable 24-case sample selected from the blind Blue Book index before any manual case substitution can occur.

sample_freeze.replacement_rule: FORBIDDEN. Failed or inaccessible validation cases remain in the manifest and count against admission.

cross_mirror_check.secondary_index: UAP/ARCHIVES public timeline/index of declassified USAF/NARA-linked documents

confirmed_sample_naid_examples.expected_context: 1950 New Haven, Connecticut STARLIKE-positive sample row
confirmed_sample_naid_examples.cross_mirror_result: USAF 28938500 independently appears in UAP/ARCHIVES with New Haven, Connecticut context
USAF 28938901 independently appears in UAP/ARCHIVES with Stewart Air Force Base context
USAF 28939312 independently appears in UAP/ARCHIVES timeline/index

cross_mirror_check.important_boundary: Search/index visibility is incomplete and cannot be treated as evidence that absent search hits are absent from NARA. Independent mirror presence validates identifier/context only to the extent shown; it does not validate occurrence date or STARLIKE phenotype unless the underlying source record is inspected.

official_provenance_context.NARA_statement: NARA holds Project Blue Book case files, individual sightings are arranged chronologically, and finding aids include an index by date and location; T1206 contains the microfilmed records.
official_provenance_context.NARA_bulk_context: NARA publicly lists Project Blue Book Case Files series 595466 and the much larger sanitized case-file image series 597821.
official_provenance_context.population_boundary: NARA reports 12,618 sightings over the project lifetime, of which 701 remained unidentified; the 5,144-page convenience mirror has not been established as that complete denominator.

effect_on_statistical_result: The preregistered permutation computation remains reproducible from the frozen blind index and does not change because validation is incomplete. The incomplete spot-check limits admission/authority and confidence in parser transport; it does not authorize post-hoc alteration of case membership or phenotype rules.
next_validation_route: Prefer NARA sanitized source scans / T1206-derived public files when individually addressable without API credentials.
Use UAP/ARCHIVES or another NARA-linked mirror only as an independent cross-check, never as sole primary authority.
For every frozen sample row record NAID match, occurrence-date match, STARLIKE/negative wording match and any parser discrepancy.
Do not replace unavailable or failing rows.
